name: Gelaro S4 GRX400

editorial.verdict: Closest conventional alternative to Twitter when Shimano serviceability and a published 45C maximum matter more than electronic shifting.
caveats: Usually costs more than Twitter EDS with less headline component value
T800 label does not independently prove better frame execution
